title: A test script's acts in DCLab Code are never a person's labels
request: You have a $20 budget to test dclab-code live: find bugs and fix them, and keep every record for training.
plan: Find in the live test's records who made each click
Give the fix to DCLab Code itself, in its own copy of R&D, in plan mode (a real task for the live test)
Check its change, carry it into R&D by hand, and extend it to every kind of act
Review, fix the review's findings, then commit

decisions.decision: A record is the person's only when its by is "person" or absent
decisions.why: records older than by are the person's; anything else (the app, a test script, a typo) must never become a gold label

decisions.decision: Keep the M6 facts and mark them _by_script, rather than drop or cancel the steps
decisions.why: the store keeps records and drops only labels (S8); a script's approval did switch the mode and its allowed step did run

decisions.decision: A script's undo or commit still cuts a file's history, with no verdict
decisions.why: otherwise a later commit by the person would take credit for changes the script already settled

decisions.decision: The live-test homes are marked in their configs, not rewritten
decisions.why: records are append-only and kept whole; the folder's scripted.json already says no label there is human

change: sets/dclab_code.py: by_person(); _auto stays a fact (the app answered); each decision carries _person and each step person; labels (m1/m2 permission and plan choices, m7 steps, plans, preferences for m7 and m5, grades) only from the person; undos and commits carry person and cut file_verdicts without a verdict when a script's; M6 outcomes and the episode outcome marked _by_script. dclab-code v1.9 records by on every act (decidedBy).

findings.defect: a test script's clicks were recorded as the person's
findings.scenario: the live test's page script allowed 9 DCLab steps and graded a turn Good; every record said by: "person", so they would have become gold m1/m2 labels and m7 judgements
findings.cause: DCLab Code knew only two actors, the person and the app
findings.fix: DCLab Code's decidedBy config; the builder reads by on every act

findings.defect: a script's grade, commit and merge were still read as the person's
findings.scenario: after the first one-line fix (in _auto), a script's Good still made an m7 answer judgement and its commit a committed verdict
findings.cause: grades and commits never went through _auto
findings.fix: by_person() on grades, undos, commands, commits and merges

findings.defect: a script's undo did not cut a file's history
findings.scenario: an edit, a script's undo, then the person's merge credited the undone edit as committed
findings.cause: the undo was skipped whole, so the edit stayed pending
findings.fix: a script's undo and commit cut the history with no verdict

findings.defect: a script's decisions turned into cancelled steps in the M6 episode
findings.scenario: plan mode, a script approves auto and allows a Bash step that runs: the episode said (ExitPlanMode, plan_only, cancelled), (Bash, plan_only, cancelled) instead of plan_auto then auto_edits allowed_ok
findings.cause: _auto was widened to mean a script answered, and _auto drives the mode switch and the cancelled outcome
findings.fix: _auto stays a fact; who decided is a separate field, required only where labels are made; outcomes marked _by_script

findings.defect: a script's merge set the episode's outcome to merged
findings.scenario: a test home's script merges: the episode said the person kept the work

findings.defect: the test did not guard plans, preferences, answers or the episode
findings.scenario: dropping the person check in preferences() passed every test
findings.cause: the first test asserted only permission labels, steps, grades and changes
findings.fix: the session holds a script's plan approval, answer, deny before a same-tool step, commit, undo and merge; every set and the episode's whole step list are asserted; six mutations each fail it

measurements.name: store tests and the store check
measurements.gate: every DCLab Code set test passes, each of the six cuts fails the new test when removed, and the store check passes all its checks
measurements.result: test_store_dclab_code_sets 6 passed; 6 of 6 mutations caught; store check 28 of 28
limits: the live test's own records predate by: script and are kept apart (agent_runs/live_tests, scripted.json)

measurements.name: the fix's first version made by DCLab Code in a live session
measurements.gate: its test fails before its change and passes after
measurements.result: test written first and seen failing, one-line change, 6 of 6 passed (Sonnet 5.5, plan mode, own copy, $0.30)
limits: it covered permission decisions only; grades, commits and undos were added by hand

outcome: No act of a test script in DCLab Code becomes a person's label; the episodes keep what happened, marked as the script's.
lessons: When a flag gains a second meaning, every reader of the flag changes meaning too: add a new field instead
A live test that clicks for the person must say so in its own records, not only in a folder marker
Give the tool under test a real task from the test itself: the plan card, Keep planning and the question card were all exercised on work worth doing
risks: records made before dclab-code v1.9 in a test home still say person; only the folder marker protects them
